label: Machines that work in the real world.
intro: A robot has to do more than work once in a controlled lab. Our advanced robotics programme brings together embodied intelligence, dependable navigation and coordinated machines to tackle that next step.
caption: Engineers working with a quadruped prototype in the ARTPARK workspace.
tracks: Humanoid systems
Robotic platforms being developed for applications including factory automation and healthcare assistance.
Resilient multi-robot systems
Coordination across aerial, ground and underwater platforms, with an emphasis on robust operation.
Secure navigation
Combining GNSS, LiDAR and inertial sensing to help autonomous systems understand where they are.
Physical AI
Connecting learning, robotics data and foundation models to the physical behaviour of machines.
projects: Meet the work on collaborative, resilient robotic systems and the people building it.
Explore the shared engineering environment for hardware, fabrication and testing.

label: Better decisions, closer to the front line.
intro: Health systems need useful information before risks become crises. ARTPARK's health work connects data, modelling and AI with public-health partners, including environmental surveillance, heat risk and tools for frontline care.
caption: Phone-based oral screening and information capture, from ARTPARK's health initiatives.
tracks: Environmental surveillance
Using environmental data to help public-health teams understand and monitor emerging risks.
Climate and health
Heat-health forecasting and disease-risk modelling, connecting climate signals to health-system planning.
AI for frontline work
Exploring copilots and evaluation tools with the people who will use them in real care settings.
Research data infrastructure
Medical imaging datasets and research infrastructure through MIDAS.
projects: Explore the programme's approach to monitoring environmental signals for public health.
Data and modelling work focused on dengue risk.
AI assistance developed around maternal-health workflows.
Explore project resources and datasets from the ARTPARK health team.

label: AI should understand the people it serves.
intro: India's languages cannot be represented by a single clean recording in a studio. Our language initiatives build speech resources and technology around real speakers, regional variation and the way people actually talk.
caption: Speech-data software work at an ARTPARK workstation. Original photograph from the ARTPARK Culture collection.
tracks: Vaani · speech data
The IISc–ARTPARK initiative, funded by Google, collects diverse speech to support Indian-language AI.
RESPIN · recognition
Research on recognising speech in Indian languages, including variation across speakers and regions.
SYSPIN · synthesis
Work on synthesising speech in Indian languages for more accessible digital interaction.
projects: Browse the project dashboard, approach and published resources.
Access Vaani's published speech resources on Hugging Face.
Discover the speech recognition and synthesis initiatives.

label: Build it. Connect it. Test it for real.
intro: A connected system is only as useful as its performance outside a slide deck. The Centre of Excellence for Wired & Wireless Technologies provides a setting to develop and test communications, edge intelligence and connected applications.
caption: A 5G drone prototype featured in ARTPARK’s Wired & Wireless Technologies test lab.
tracks: 5G test infrastructure
A real network environment at ARTgarage for developing and demonstrating connected applications.
Robotics and edge AI
Connected UAVs and ground vehicles, edge processing and networked autonomous systems.
Industry use cases
Application work spanning precision agriculture, immersive experiences and connected response systems.
Skills and collaboration
Training and demonstrations that bring academia, startups and industry into the same environment.
projects: See the infrastructure and connected-systems development environment.
Explore the programme's facilities, focus areas and collaboration opportunities.

label: Technology shaped around people and production.
intro: Industrial transformation starts with a specific operational problem. This programme brings industry and research together around fragmented data, supply-chain agility, environmental pressures and the practical use of AI and automation.
caption: Hardware engineering and testing in the ARTPARK robotics lab.
tracks: Connected operations
Digital twins and asset tracking that connect information to what is happening on the ground.
AI in the workflow
Exploring generative AI and analytics around real operational decisions.
Human-centred automation
Collaborative robotics and automation designed around the people using them.
Resource-aware production
Co-innovation around productivity, energy use and sustainable operations.
projects: Explore the programme's approach to people-centric industrial innovation.
Discuss a use case, research question or engineering collaboration with ARTPARK.

label: The space between an idea and a venture.
intro: Not every promising technology begins as a company. ARTLabs supports researchers, engineers and entrepreneurs as they turn early ideas into prototypes, investigate real needs and explore a path towards a venture.
caption: Hands-on electronics prototyping at ARTLabs.
tracks: Ideas into prototypes
A practical environment for innovators to make and test tangible technology.
Early validation
Testing assumptions about the problem, the user and the value a technology can create.
Innovators-in-Residence
Innovation projects with a route towards product and venture exploration.
projects: The programme lists projects including Taksa, Idle Robotics, Zetesis and Cold Chain Systems.
Explore Technology Innovators in Residence and the Venture Incubation Programme.

label: Learn by working on what comes next.
intro: Deep tech needs people who can move between theory, tools and the messy reality of making things work. The Academy connects learners and practitioners through technical training, workshops and research-linked learning.
caption: An engineering discussion in the lab: learning through shared technical work.
tracks: Hands-on technical learning
Workshops and training in robotics, AI and wired and wireless technologies.
Research exposure
Fellowships and internships connecting undergraduate and postgraduate learners to technical work.
Entrepreneurship conversations
Spark Sessions connect aspiring entrepreneurs with people building technology and ventures.
